page.layout: One page, a single title block centred, with a printer's ornament line between the title and the imprint. Handwritten shelfmark at the top right (not transcribed).
page.notes: No page number, running head, catchword or signature. The printer's ornament line between "Archiv." and "impressa" is decorative, not text, and is not transcribed. The handwritten shelfmark "A 526" at the top right is excluded. The date line reads cIↄ IↄC LXXIX, i.e. MDCLXXIX (1679); the "C" under the "Iↄ" is a printer's correction and is read as part of the DC. "Sereniss." is an abbreviation (Serenissimi) printed with a long s; it is given as Sereniss. with plain s in the text: "Sereniss." would be the expanded spelling, but the printed form is kept. "Reyheri" in the imprint is set in a worn face; the final letter is read as i with [?] omitted, since it is clear enough.
